operation.description:
Read operation. Retrieve all required pages before reporting complete totals. Returns a single payment method by id. This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token.

The record is returned **flat** (not wrapped in a `data` envelope) and embeds its related `branch` object and `treasury` (null when no treasury is linked). The fields `site_id`, `category`, and `credentials` are not returned.

The trailing path segment (`1`) is the **data level** — how deeply related records are loaded — not meaningful here, so `/site_payment_gateway/{ID}` and `/site_payment_gateway/{ID}/1` return the same result.

> Requesting an id that does not exist currently returns HTTP `500` with the plain-text body `error happened` (not a `404`).

parameters.name: ID
parameters.description: Id of the payment method to retrieve.

200.description: The payment method, returned as a flat object.

schema.description: A single payment-method record, returned flat (not wrapped).

payment_gateway.description: Gateway key/identifier for this payment method (unique within the account).

default.description:
Whether this is the account's default payment method.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Not the default |
| 1 | Default |

active.description:
Whether the payment method is enabled.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Disabled |
| 1 | Enabled |

manually_added.description:
Whether the method was added manually.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | No |
| 1 | Yes |

disable_for_client.description:
Whether the method is hidden from the client portal.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | Visible |
| 1 | Hidden |

treasury_id.description: Id of the linked treasury, or null.

branch_id.description: Id of the branch this method belongs to.

branch.description: The branch this payment method belongs to.

treasury.description: The linked treasury, or null when none is linked.

401.description: Authentication or authorization failed. A missing, invalid, or expired Bearer token returns a plain `401` (no JSON body). An authenticated caller who lacks permission receives `{ "error": "You are not allowed to view this page" }`.

500.description: Requesting an id that does not exist currently returns HTTP 500 with the plain-text body `error happened`.

schema.description: Plain-text body `error happened`. Currently returned when the requested id does not exist (rather than a 404).
